text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Oh, everyone's here? Good work with the 
fishing contest yesterday~. 
Alright then, today we're—”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what's wrong? You've got this look 
on your face like, 'I was draining my 
instant yakisoba and accidentally dumped 
the whole thing down the sink!'"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "......Um. The truth is—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yesterday, I got a call from the Student 
Council President... inviting me to a mock 
race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"However, it was scheduled for today... so 
I politely declined, but—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...If I could run alongside the President 
and the others, I... found myself wishing 
I could have prioritized that instead."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...'Resting is just as important in order 
to reach the destination known as 
Victory.' In other words, resting isn't 
'standing still,' it's a necessary step—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That is what Bright-san taught me. But... 
I only merely believed that I had 
understood it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I am so sorry. Even though I already had 
prior plans with all of you... I..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm~. How should I put this~? As 
expected, you're just way too serious..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Too serious, you say...?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, whatever~! Let's just go have 
some fun~☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright! The 'Ultimate Nap Spot 
Championship' is reaching its climax! 
Which one of us will take the crown~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, pick me, pick me! Sky-senpai! What 
about over there? Doesn't it look super 
nappable? We could just buy a giant 
cushion and drop it down!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"You could nap anywhere if you just bought 
a giant cushion! You've got it all wrong, 
Pandora! An ideal nap spot needs to have—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Plenty of sunlight. Tree roots for a 
pillow. Hidden from the teachers. Easy to 
reach. A roof. And most importantly, 
hidden from the teachers!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Aren't your demands a bit excessive?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(......Knowing Sky-san, there has to be a 
deeper meaning to this, right?? Even to 
this childish, seemingly... utterly 
pointless game.)"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(...Still, if we're going to play, 
wouldn't something more constructive be... 
No, perhaps there is meaning in this very 
'pointlessness.' In her own way.)"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, a cat! A brown tabby. ...Look at that 
delightfully cocky face. Nice, I like 
him!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Ufufu. It's a kitty, isn't it~. Meow 
meow♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"He's wearing a collar, so he must be a 
pet, right? Such glossy fur... You must be 
pampered rotten, aren't you, buddy~? Who's 
a good boy?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(...Fufu, so cute. Just watching him 
feels so soothing... —Wait, soothing? 
...Comfort!)"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(I see. Maybe Sky-san is trying to teach 
me that rest needs to provide 'comfort'? 
That this is one of the essential 
nutrients for racing—)"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I know☆! Ai-chan, Ai-chan! Let's take 
a photo together with the kitty! Ready, 
love and peace♡"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Ah... peace?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey. Look at that. 
What does that cloud look like to you?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Eh, that cloud? Let me see... Hmmm... Ah! 
Could it be 'a brave hero who is just 
about to draw their sword'?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~? That's so specific... Wait, really? 
Now that you mention it, it kinda does... 
Oh, classic Kiseki~."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, then how about that! That cloud over 
there... A furlong pole! Doesn't it look 
like a furlong pole?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? Ah~... Yeah, I guess? It kinda does 
look like one, sure."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(H-Huh? Was that not it? Isn't the point 
that casual chatter with friends is 
essential to unwinding...?)"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"(Ah, was it because it was a furlong 
pole?! Was she trying to say... that I 
should forget about racing when looking at 
the clouds...?)"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Haaaah............ Such nice weather."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Sky-san! Please, let me confirm 
something!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Hmm~? Confirm what?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The true intention behind this rest you 
arranged! I gave it a lot of thought... 
about the meaning behind every single game 
we played with everyone."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"This time is meant to be a sort of detox 
to heal our minds and bodies for our next 
race—which is why we're deliberately doing 
things completely unrelated to racing, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"There's really no deep meaning behind 
it~."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "There is NO meaning at all?!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, ahh?! I-I am so sorry! For dropping 
my formal tone just now... Wait... but, 
huh...?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha☆! Aren't you overreacting just a 
little? I knew it, you've definitely got a 
cute side to you~."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please don't tease me...! Or rather, if 
that's the case... then why on earth am 
I..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. But you know, Ai. 
It might be completely pointless—and yet."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it nice to have moments like this 
every once in a while?"
